note: "  xterm-decoration-container — xterm.js DOM, styled by the sheet it injects at runtime"
note: "  composition-view — xterm.js DOM (IME composition), styled by the sheet it injects at runtime"
note: "  terminal — a VIEW NAME; the element's .view class does the styling"
note: "  warn — the boot chip's tone modifier. The BASE rule paints it — .boot-mark is the warn triangle and .boot-mark.info is the exception — so the name needs no rule of its own. Round 121 followed it anyway, and found a real defect behind it: the triangle used --state-warn, which measures 2.80 on the dark chip surface against the 3:1 a graphic needs. Fixed to --warn-ink (6.45 / 8.76)."
